title: (Fact) Check Your Bias
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of parametric and prompted biases in LLMs on fact-verification tasks. While it mentions normative bias in its terminology section and acknowledges the existence of religious bias in literature, its own experimental evaluation is based on factual claims about public figures (e.g., Matt Gaetz, Sean Connery) and does not contain a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
